title: Compute brief - 7 October 2026
description: Three Wire ids: CoreWeave enters India as sole tenant of a 240 MW AdaniConneX campus in Navi Mumbai; Black Hills signs definitive agreements to serve Google's planned Cheyenne, Wyoming campus with a 2.7 GW resource mix; TeraWulf doubles contracted power at Muskie, Kentucky to 1 GW. Silicon Tape confirm day (69/0/0); AWS's 7 Oct Capacity Blocks card is still a banner, not in the live table.
og_kicker: CoreWeave lands in India; Google's 2.7 GW in Wyoming
lede: Wednesday's three conversions are about who controls the power. CoreWeave entered India as sole tenant of a 240 MW AdaniConneX campus at Taloja, Navi Mumbai, with Vera Rubin planned and first capacity in mid-2028. Black Hills signed definitive agreements, effective 30 Sep and running through 2048, to serve Google's planned Cheyenne, Wyoming data center with a 2.7 GW resource mix, including $1.8 billion of new gas generation and a 2.1 GW private microgrid, ramping from late 2027 to peak in 2030. TeraWulf doubled contracted power at its Muskie campus in Kentucky to 1 GW and pulled the second 500 MW into 2029, subject to the Kentucky PSC. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. AWS's Capacity Blocks banner says new rates take effect 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146), but the live table at publish still prints P5 $5.191 and P6-B300 $14.04, so no tick is recorded. Brookwood's council backed the TCEDA agreement on 6 Oct; the Alabama PSC power vote is next. Applied Digital reports FQ1 after the close today.
